column1: # Cover crop species parameters -- Midwest / Iowa calibration
# Values below are reasonable Midwest extension figures assembled to unblock
# the build. Every row needs checking against SARE "Managing Cover Crops
# Profitably" 3rd ed. (free PDF from sare.org) and the page number written
# into the citation column. The `verified` column is the checklist.
# B2 owns this file (plan bottleneck B11). Budget half a day. Cap at 12
# species -- twelve is plenty for a demo and this expands if you let it.
#   tbase_c          : base temperature for GDD accumulation
#   gdd_establish    : GDD (at tbase_c) from seeding to an established stand
#   winterkill_c     : temp at which the stand dies; -99 = reliably hardy here
#   n_credit_kg_ha   : N credited to the following cash crop (legumes only)
